essence: The weapon for the subtle form is the mantra formula huṃphaḍ.
The deity holds a pair of red lotuses and displays boon and fearlessness.
After invoking the god, the mantra-knower should worship him on the previously mentioned seat.
One should offer a tenth part using bilva and palāśa-born materials.
The offering should use excellent udumbara firewood sticks smeared with the three sweets.
